Enable OBO backend API app registration for user-delegated access to Agent Service
When true (with enableObo), the SPA and backend (OBO) share ONE app registration instead of two. Set via USE_UNIFIED_APP_CLIENT.

Reuse an EXISTING backend (OBO) app registration (client ID) instead of creating one, in two-app mode. Set via ENTRA_EXISTING_BACKEND_CLIENT_ID.

backendClientAppId.value: [if(not(parameters('enableObo')), '', if(parameters('useUnifiedAppClient'), if(variables('createSpaApp'), reference('app').appId, parameters('existingSpaClientId')), if(variables('createBackendApp'), reference('backendApp').appId, parameters('existingBackendClientId'))))]

containers.name: [parameters('name')]
containers.probes: [if(not(empty(parameters('healthProbePath'))), createArray(createObject('type', 'Liveness', 'httpGet', createObject('path', parameters('healthProbePath'), 'port', parameters('targetPort')), 'periodSeconds', 30, 'failureThreshold', 3), createObject('type', 'Startup', 'httpGet', createObject('path', parameters('healthProbePath'), 'port', parameters('targetPort')), 'periodSeconds', 10, 'failureThreshold', 30, 'initialDelaySeconds', 5)), createArray())]
